scope: actual built workspace/model and real CustomerFollowup controls; isolated VM stores only

tests.name: work queues use authoritative states and sort the full matching set before pagination without mutating rows
primary next action follows model permissions and a read-only row never gets a transfer control
AI batch start is explicit, each result is reported, and same-number occupancy is not presented as all-success
manual businesses are never submitted through the AI/predictive batch-start entry
unknown batch submission reconciles the same request and never submits another batch
CORRECTION reopens with an explicit reason and preserves the existing business owner and identity
terminal reclassification previews exact target fields and preserves the original run and sealed content
changing reclassification values invalidates preview and never silently reuses the old confirmation
contact policy defaults are explicit, admin saves scope and priority, and operator cannot open maintenance
business outcome and workflow state render independently and unknown historical outcomes are not guessed
manual assignment explains unavailable telephone qualifications without any seat or resource picker
possible AI entry does not force an AI scene on a row whose actual entry is no-call END
cross-midnight calls show verified dial time separately from queue time and retain updated-first ordering
queued and legacy calls never substitute an unverified queue timestamp for actual dial time
batch preview keeps a temporarily blocked row while another authorized row can still start
